1890.s: The two younger women wore their Sunday frocks — Mora's being the much loathed grey, somewhat disguised by a white fichu unearthed from some long discarded finery of Mrs. Blake's, the new black silk having been discarded by Maggie in set terms.

1900.s: The domino, whom I called upon for a proof of her assertion, whispered my name under the lace of her — mask, pronouncing it very nicely with a pretty little Russian accent which the disguised voice did not prevent my noting.
